en.headline: Police arrest 28-year-old over alleged theft of more than 100 items at Disneyland
en.dek: A mainland tourist was held after security reported he took keychains and reusable bags valued at about HK$20,000 from park shops on Friday evening.
body: Police arrested a 28-year-old mainland man on suspicion of shop theft after Hong Kong Disneyland security reported he had taken more than 100 items from park shops on Friday evening.
The items, mainly keychains and reusable bags, were valued at about HK$20,000. Because of the large number, staff needed time to count them before reporting the matter to police around 11pm.
The man, who entered Hong Kong on a two-way permit for tourism, was detained for investigation. The case is being handled by the Lantau North District crime unit.
Hong Kong Disneyland has not released a further statement on the incident. Police said the investigation is continuing.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕28歲內地男 涉迪士尼樂園偷逾百件商品
zh.dek: 保安報稱該名持雙程證來港的遊客於周五晚在園內偷取大量鎖匙扣及環保袋，總值約2萬元，因數量多至晚上11時許才報案。
body: 警方以涉嫌店舖盜竊拘捕一名28歲內地男子，事緣香港迪士尼樂園保安周五晚上報稱有人在園內偷取逾100件商品。
涉案物品主要為鎖匙扣及環保袋，總值約2萬元。由於數量龐大，職員需時清點，至晚上約11時才向警方報案。
被捕男子持雙程證來港旅遊，現正被扣留調查。案件由大嶼山警區刑事調查隊跟進。
香港迪士尼樂園暫未就事件發表進一步聲明。警方表示調查仍在進行。
